conceptDrafts.logline: When a cul-de-sac HOA discovers the thing under the retention pond honors any rule passed by majority vote, the board's pettiest tyrant becomes the neighborhood's only qualified demonologist.

references.title: What We Do in the Shadows

settings.vibe: laminated agendas vs ancient evil; fluorescent clubhouse dread
settings.toneNote: the horror is real and the comedy is procedural — nobody winks at the camera

concept.summary: Pinehurst Commons has 47 homes, a retention pond, and a thing in the pond that has eaten a resident every June since 1988 — but only residents in violation of the bylaws. Carol Bench, the HOA president everyone despises for her citation-happy clipboard raj, realizes her unbearable rulebook is the only fence holding the thing in. When a new board majority votes to dissolve the covenants and sell to a developer, Carol has until the June meeting to keep 46 households in perfect compliance — or feed the pond the two-thirds quorum it needs.

characters.name: Carol Bench
characters.backstory: Twenty-two years as HOA president; wrote the 340-page covenant herself after what happened to the Kowalskis in '03.
characters.motivations: Keep the pond fed on citations instead of neighbors.
characters.flaws: Would rather be feared and right than believed.
characters.need: One neighbor who follows the rules because they trust her, not because they fear the fine.

relationships.description: public enemy — Dev leads the vote to dissolve the covenants; privately he is the only board member who has read all 340 pages

characters.voice: citation numbers as punctuation; never raises her volume, only her specificity
characters.arc: From enforcing the rules to explaining them.

characters.name: Dev Okonkwo
characters.backstory: Moved in three years ago; flipping four properties; June 1988 means nothing to him.
characters.motivations: Dissolve the HOA, close the sale, move the family somewhere with a better school district.
characters.flaws: Mistakes Carol's fear for control-freakery because that's cheaper than believing her.
characters.want: The dissolution vote passed before the developer's option expires.
characters.need: To read the minutes from June 1988.

relationships.description: sees Carol as the last obstacle between his family and a clean exit

characters.voice: spreadsheet reasonableness; jokes to defuse, then regrets the joke
